Package com.here.sdk.mapdata.ocm

Class BuildingAttributeNames

java.lang.Object
com.here.sdk.mapdata.ocm.BuildingAttributeNames
public final class BuildingAttributeNames extends Object

List of attribute names for geometry data loaded through MapTileDataSource for MapTileDataLayer.BUILDING_FOOTPRINTS data layer.

Note: This is a beta release of this feature and may contain bugs or exhibit unexpected behaviour. Related APIs are subject to change without a deprecation process.

  • Field Details

    • HEIGHT_IN_METERS

      public static final String HEIGHT_IN_METERS

      The height of the building extrusion in meters above the base of the building. If zero, the feature only represents the footprint of the building as a polygon.

      Type: Int64

      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • GROUND_CLEARANCE_IN_METERS

      public static final String GROUND_CLEARANCE_IN_METERS

      The ground clearance of the extrusion in meters above grade. Required. A value of 0 indicates that the base of the building is at grade.

      Type: Int64

      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • Z_INDEX

      public static final String Z_INDEX

      Altitude order, relative to other buildings at the same position. In particular, values less than 0 represent underground buildings.

      Type: Int64

      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • CATEGORY_ID

      public static final String CATEGORY_ID

      The identifier of the category this building belongs to.

      The identifier format is the same as in HERE Map Content, typically of the form domain:system:type:id.

      The default category here:cm:building-category:2005700 (Unclassified) is omitted.

      Empty if no category is assigned.

      Type: String
